description: UC Berkeley — strong CA in-state applicant, RD, CS major
rationale: UCB resolves to the Tier-2 overall anchor (~11%) under the CI gate DB: cds-admit-bands are seeded by the orchestrator (pnpm db:seed), NOT by `prisma db seed`/seed.ts which the gate runs, so the resident GPA band is absent there. Strong CA in-state = overall 0.11 × CA-1.35 (2026-05-31 audit value) × stats ≈ 0.16 — a reach (UCB is brutally selective even for strong residents). Range [0.12, 0.3]. (NOTE: under the orchestrator seed the Tier-1 resident band 0.25 applies; an in-state multiplier on top would double-count — see §7.11 deferred UC item.)
